title: Aug 3 — South Jeju
text:
Monday · August 3, 2026 · Day 9 of 15
  South Jeju 🍵
  📍 Yeomiji Botanical Garden · Osulloc Tea Museum · Comma Cafe · Jeju



Morning


  09:30
  
    🌸 Garden
    Yeomiji Botanical Garden
    Asia's largest botanical garden with 3,800+ species across themed greenhouses (tropical, subtropical, Mediterranean, desert) and beautiful outdoor gardens. The glass pyramids and cactus house are highlights. Entry ~₩14,000. Allow 2 hours.
    
      📍 Yeomiji
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Lunch


  12:00
  
    🍜 Lunch
    Jeju Sun Buckwheat Noodles (메밀국수)
    Jeju-style buckwheat noodles in a light broth — a regional specialty. The noodles are hand-made and the flavour is earthy and nutty. Perfect light lunch before the tea museum.
    
      📍 Buckwheat Noodles
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Afternoon — Tea Country


  14:00
  
    🍵 Museum
    Osulloc Tea Museum
    Korea's premier green tea museum set amid rolling tea plantations. The museum covers 4,000 years of Korean tea culture. Surrounded by Innisfree's green tea fields (same company). Must-try:
      
        Osulloc green tea ice cream (삼다도 아이스크림)
        Fresh brewed premium green tea
        Tea field walk for photos
      
      Free admission to museum grounds and gardens. In-store experiences cost extra.
    
    
      📍 Osulloc
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  16:30
  
    ☕ Cafe
    Comma Cafe
    A peaceful, scenic cafe in the west Jeju area. Good for an afternoon coffee and dessert with views over the tea fields or coastal landscape.
    
      📍 Comma Cafe
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Dinner


  19:00
  
    FREE NIGHT🍽️ Dinner
    Free Night — Explore Jeju City
    Final evening in Jeju! Options:
      
        Jeju-style BBQ or galchi (hairtail fish) near the hotel
        Dongmun Night Market revisit
        Seafood raw fish restaurant (회) along the coast
      
    
    
      📍 Find Dinner
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Last night in Jeju! Check out tomorrow morning — flight to Busan at 13:00. Pack tonight and return rental car to Jeju One Car near airport before check-in.

title: Aug 1 — East Jeju
text:
Saturday · August 1, 2026 · Day 7 of 15
  East Jeju 🌅
  📍 Seongsan · Haenyeo Show · Gwangchigi Beach · Umu & Gamttanam · Jeju



Early Morning — Sunrise Hike


  05:30
  
    🌅 Sunrise
    Hike Seongsan Ilchulbong (Sunrise Peak)
    UNESCO World Heritage volcanic crater rising from the sea. The sunrise from the summit is one of Korea's most iconic sights. Trail is 20–30 min up, can be steep. Arrive before dawn to get a good spot. Entry: ₩2,000.
      
        Gate opens at 05:00 in summer
        Bring a jacket — windy at the top
        Headlamp helpful in pre-dawn dark
      
    
    
      📍 Seongsan Peak
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Midday


  12:00
  
    🍜 Lunch
    Nolaba Ramen
    Popular ramen spot near the Seongsan area. Great post-hike warm-up meal.
    
      📍 Google Maps
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  13:30
  
    🤿 Show
    Haenyeo Diver Show
    Watch Jeju's legendary female free-divers (해녀) demonstrate their tradition of diving without equipment to harvest abalone, sea urchin, and seaweed. A living piece of UNESCO Intangible Heritage.
    
      📍 Haenyeo Show
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Afternoon — Beach & Cafe


  15:00
  
    🏖️ Beach
    Gwangchigi Beach
    Scenic east-coast beach with black lava rocks and Seongsan Ilchulbong as a backdrop. Great for swimming or just relaxing.
    
      📍 Gwangchigi Beach
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  16:30
  
    ☕ Cafe
    Umu Cafe
    Scenic cafe near Seongsan with ocean views. Great for afternoon coffee and views back to the volcanic peak.
    
      📍 Umu
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  17:00
  
    🍊 Cafe
    Gamttanam — Orange Cafe
    Famous orange/tangerine themed cafe in Jeju. The island is famous for hallabong citrus, and this cafe uses them in drinks and desserts.
    
      📍 Google Maps
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Dinner


  19:30
  
    🐷 DinnerFind it
    Jeju Black Pork BBQ (흑돼지)
    Jeju's signature dish — black Berkshire pigs raised on the island, with distinctly richer flavour. Best enjoyed as thick slices of pork belly (samgyeopsal) grilled over charcoal. Research a spot near your area for the evening.
    
      📍 Search Black Pork
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Set alarms early — 05:00 wake-up for sunrise. Drive from Jeju City to Seongsan is ~45 min. Cafes and restaurants near Seongsan open from ~08:00.

Evening — Myeongdong


  18:00
  
    🛍️ Shopping
    Explore Myeongdong
    One of Seoul's most iconic shopping & street food districts. Packed with K-beauty, fashion, and snacks.
    
      📍 Myeongdong
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  18:15
  
    💄 Beauty
    Olive Young Haul
    Korea's biggest K-beauty chain. Tax-free shopping available with passport. Stock up on sheet masks, sunscreens, toners.
    
      📍 Olive Young Myeongdong
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  18:30
  
    🍽️ Dinner
    NYU NYU Myeongdong
    Popular snack stop in Myeongdong.
    
      📍 NYU NYU
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Dinner — Choose One


  19:00
  
    🥟 Option A
    Gwangjang Market
    Seoul's oldest market. Famous for: Bindaetteok (mung bean pancakes)Mayak gimbap (bite-sized rolls)Yukhoe (Korean beef tartare)Great atmosphere day and night.
    
      📍 Gwangjang Market
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  19:00
  
    🥟 Option B⚠️ Closes 19:30
    Gamekol Son Wangmandu
    Hand-made giant dumplings. Closes at 19:30 — go early or skip to Gwangjang.
    
      📍 Gamekol Map
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Late Night (Optional)


  22:00+
  
    🌙 Late Night
    흑우정 소갈비 전문점 — Korean BBQ (24 hr)
    24-hour Korean BBQ specialising in premium beef short ribs (소갈비). Perfect if jet lag keeps you up.
    
      📍 Google Maps
      🗺 Naver
    
  


  💤
  
    😴 Jet Lag Strategy
    Arrival Day Sleep Plan — Survive Tonight
    
      You land at 16:05 KST but your body clock reads midnight Vancouver time. The key is to hold out until a reasonable Korean bedtime without crashing early. One bad nap now can knock your sleep schedule off for days.
      

        
          16:05–18:00 KST00:05–02:00 PDT
          ⚠️ Do NOT nap — even lying down "just for 20 min" will become 3 hours. Get the SIM, take the bus, check in, and go straight outside. Movement helps.
        

        
          18:00–21:00 KST02:00–05:00 PDT
          Stay busy — Myeongdong, Olive Young, dinner at Gwangjang Market. Bright lights, food, and walking are your best friend right now. Eat a proper dinner even if you're not hungry.
        

        
          21:00–22:00 KST05:00–06:00 PDT
          😴 Bedtime — this is your target. Take a melatonin (0.5–1mg), shower, black out the room. Don't fight it past 22:00 — earlier is fine.
        

        
          07:00–08:00 KST15:00–16:00 PDT
          Wake up — set an alarm. Your body clock will likely wake you earlier (Vancouver afternoon = Seoul early morning). Get up, open curtains, get sunlight. Day 2 starts fresh. ☀️
        

      
      ☀️ Sunlight is the strongest reset signal — get outside in the morning on Day 2 (Jul 28). Breakfast on the hotel terrace or a walk before the Gangnam day helps lock in your new rhythm.
    
  


Breakfast included at hotel daily. · T-Money: comes free with your LG U+ SIM — top it up at any convenience store or subway machine.

title: Aug 4 — Jeju → Busan
text:
Tuesday · August 4, 2026 · Day 10 of 15
  Jeju → Busan ✈️🌊
  📍 Jeju Airport → Busan · Haeundae Beach · Haeundae Market · Anmok



Morning — Departure Prep


  09:00
  
    🚗 Return Car
    Return Rental Car & Hotel Check Out
    Return Jeju One Car rental near the airport. Check out of Grabel Hotel Jeju. Head to Jeju Airport for the afternoon flight.
    
      📍 Jeju Airport
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Afternoon — Flight to Busan


  13:00
  
    ✈️ Departure
    Depart Jeju → Busan (Gimhae)
    ~55 min flight from Jeju (CJU) to Busan Gimhae International Airport (PUS).
    
      📍 CJU Airport
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  14:05
  
    🛬 Arrival
    Arrive Busan — Gimhae Airport (PUS)
    Take the Busan-Gimhae Light Railway (BGL) or bus to Haeundae. Journey ~1 hour to Haeundae Beach area.
    
      📍 PUS Airport
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  16:00
  
    BOOKED ✓🏨 Check-in
    Check In — L7 Haeundae by Lotte Hotels
    55 Haeun-daero 570beon-gil, Haeundae-gu, Busan. 3 nights (Aug 4–6). Breakfast included — buffet at Floating restaurant, 2F. Rated 9.5/10 (2,540 reviews).
    
      📍 L7 Haeundae
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Evening


  17:00
  
    🏖️ Beach
    Haeundae Beach
    Korea's most famous beach — 1.5km of white sand. Busy in summer but the atmosphere is electric. Great for a sunset stroll or a dip. Marine City skyline makes for a dramatic backdrop.
    
      📍 Haeundae Beach
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  18:00
  
    🛒 Market
    Haeundae Market
    Traditional market steps from the beach. Great for Busan street food — ssiat hotteok (seed-stuffed hotteok), pajeon (seafood pancake), and fresh fish.
    
      📍 Haeundae Market
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  19:30
  
    🍽️ Dinner
    Anmok
    Dinner at Anmok near Haeundae — a local favourite for fresh Busan-style dining.
    
      📍 Anmok
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Sky Capsule tomorrow — book 1 month ahead if possible. Very popular. Check availability at Haeundae Blueline Park website.

title: Jul 30 — DMZ + Euljiro
text:
Thursday · July 30, 2026 · Day 5 of 15
  DMZ + Euljiro 🪖
  📍 DMZ (6–7 hrs) · Seolleongtang · Euljiro Hidden Alleys · Hannam · Seoul



Morning — DMZ Tour


  06:30
  
    🍳 Breakfast
    Breakfast Buffet · CAFE (B1F) · Shilla Stay
    Thursday (Weekday) hours: 06:30–09:30 · ₩23,000/adult · Go early today — DMZ tour departs at 08:00. Be down by 06:30–07:00 to eat and leave by 07:20.
  



  08:00
  
    BOOKED ✓🪖 Tour
    DMZ Tour (6–7 hours)
    Guided tour of the Demilitarized Zone between North and South Korea. Typically includes:
      
        Third Infiltration Tunnel
        Dora Observatory (views into North Korea)
        Dorasan Station (the northernmost station in South Korea)
        Imjingak Park
      
      Bring your passport. No large cameras allowed in tunnels.
    
    
      📍 Tour Departure
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Late Lunch


  15:00
  
    🍲 Late Lunch
    Oegojip Seolleongtang
    Milky white ox bone broth soup (설렁탕) simmered for hours. Rich, comforting, and perfect after a long morning tour. Season to taste with salt and green onion.
    
      📍 Oegojip
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Afternoon — Euljiro Area


  16:30
  
    ☕ Explore
    Euljiro — Cafes, Record Stores & Hidden Alleys
    One of Seoul's coolest areas — industrial streets being turned into indie cafes, galleries and record shops hidden among printing workshops. Explore:
      
        Third wave coffee cafes in old factories
        Vinyl record stores (crates of K-pop and jazz)
        Hidden back alleyways and neon-lit courtyards
      
    
    
      📍 Euljiro Area
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Dinner


  18:30
  
    🍗 Dinner
    한남동한방통닭 — Hannam Oriental Rotisserie Chicken
    Slow-roasted whole chicken with Korean herbal spices. Crispy skin, juicy meat, incredible flavour. The Hannam neighbourhood is also worth a wander after dinner.
    
      📍 Google Maps
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Breakfast included at hotel. · Pack light for the DMZ — security checks at the zone. Passport required. · Last full day in Seoul before Jeju!

title: Aug 7 — Busan → Seoul
text:
Friday · August 7, 2026 · Day 13 of 15
  Busan → Seoul 🚄
  📍 KTX · Seoul Forest · Seongsu Food Crawl · Last Shopping Day · Seoul



Morning — KTX to Seoul


  10:00–11:00
  
    🚄 KTXBuy in advance
    KTX: Busan Station → Seoul Station
    High-speed train from Busan to Seoul. Target departure between 10:00–11:00 AM. Journey time ~2h 15m. Buy tickets on the Korail website or at the station. Busan KTX station is at Busan Station (city centre).
      
        Check korail.com for tickets
        Seat reservations recommended — window seat for scenery
        Arrive Seoul ~12:30–13:00
      
    
    
      📍 Busan Station
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Afternoon — Check In & Seongsu


  13:00
  
    BOOKED ✓🏨 Check-in
    Check In — Shilla Stay Seodaemun Seoul Station
    Return to Shilla Stay for final 3 nights (Aug 7–9). Breakfast included — CAFE B1F (weekdays 06:30–09:30). Drop luggage and head to Seongsu.
    
      📍 Shilla Stay Seodaemun
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  15:00
  
    🌳 Park
    Seoul Forest
    Urban forest park with deer, wetlands, and outdoor art. Great for a relaxing post-train walk through greenery.
    
      📍 Seoul Forest
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  16:00
  
    🛍️ Last Shopping
    Seongsu — Trendy Boutique District
    Seoul's Brooklyn — converted warehouses turned into independent boutiques, concept stores, and cafes. Great for unique finds and designer Korean brands.
    
      📍 Seongsu
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Food Crawl — Seongsu


  17:00
  
    🍰 Bakery
    Ggupdang Seongsu
    Popular Seongsu bakery known for crispy pastry cream buns. Usually has a queue — get there early or during off-peak hours.
    
      📍 Ggupdang
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  17:30
  
    🍓 Dessert
    Rafre Fruit Dessert Cafe Seongsu
    Seasonal fruit dessert cafe — elaborate fruit tarts, fruit shaved ice, and fruit-forward drinks. Beautiful and photogenic.
    
      📍 Rafre
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  18:00
  
    ☕ Cafe
    Soil & Tree
    Specialty coffee and natural-focused cafe in the Seongsu area.
    
      📍 Soil & Tree
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Only 2 more full days in Korea! Tomorrow: COEX, K-pop buildings, and final shopping. Plan your last must-buys tonight.

title: Jul 29 — Palace & Hanbok
text:
Wednesday · July 29, 2026 · Day 4 of 15
  Palace & Hanbok Day 👘
  📍 Gyeongbokgung · Bukchon · Seochon · Seoul Forest · Euljiro · Seoul



Morning — Hanbok & Palace


  07:30
  
    🍳 Breakfast
    Breakfast Buffet · CAFE (B1F) · Shilla Stay
    Wednesday (Weekday) hours: 06:30–09:30 · ₩23,000/adult · Arrive by 09:00 — strict closing. Early start today for 09:00 hanbok booking.
  



  09:00
  
    BOOKED ✓👘 Experience
    Studio KJD — Hanbok Rental (2.5 hrs)
    Traditional Korean hanbok dress-up + photo experience. 2.5 hours included — walk directly to Gyeongbokgung in hanbok for the full experience.
    
      📍 Studio KJD
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  09:30
  
    🏯 Sightseeing
    Gyeongbokgung Palace
    Korea's main royal palace. Free entry in hanbok! Changing of the guard ceremony at 10:00 and 14:00. One of Seoul's most photogenic spots.
    
      📍 Gyeongbokgung
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  11:00
  
    🏘️ Village
    Bukchon Hanok Village
    Preserved traditional Korean houses on a hillside. Best explored in hanbok in the morning before crowds arrive. Instagram-famous alleyway on Gahoe-ro 11-gil.
    
      📍 Bukchon
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Lunch — Seochon


  12:00
  
    🍜 Lunch
    Jalpajin Buckwheat Seochon Main
    Artisan buckwheat noodle restaurant in the charming Seochon (West Village) neighbourhood near the palace.
    
      📍 Jalpajin
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Afternoon — Explore


  13:30
  
    🍞 Snack
    Jayeondo Salt Bread (소금빵)
    Crispy, buttery Korean-style salt bread — a must-try street snack. Jayeondo Sogeumppang & Jayeondoga has legendary versions near the palace area.
    
      📍 Salt Bread Shop
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  14:30
  
    🌳 Park
    Seoul Forest
    Large urban park — good for a stroll. Deer enclosure, butterfly garden, and nice paths along the Han River tributary.
    
      📍 Seoul Forest
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  15:30
  
    🌊 Scenic
    Cheonggyecheon Stream
    Elevated highway that was turned into a beautiful urban stream. Walk along the banks through the heart of the city — a great evening stroll.
    
      📍 Cheonggyecheon
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  16:30
  
    🍮 Dessert
    Dotori Garden Anguk — Persimmon Dessert
    Specialty dessert cafe near Anguk station serving beautiful persimmon-based sweets. A unique Korean dessert experience.
    
      📍 Dotori Garden
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Dinner


  19:00
  
    🔥 Dinner
    Sancheong Charcoal Garden Euljiro — Korean BBQ
    Premium charcoal-grilled Korean BBQ in the trendy Euljiro area. Order pork belly, marinated ribs, and mix with the banchan spread.
    
      📍 Sancheong BBQ
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Evening


  21:00
  
    🌙 Evening
    Han River — Noodles & Tteok
    Evening picnic vibes at the Han River. Grab instant noodles and tteok (rice cakes) from a nearby convenience store. Yeouido Hangang Park is a popular spot.
    
      📍 Han River Park
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Breakfast included at hotel. · Hanbok tip: Free palace entry in hanbok — keep rental receipt.

title: Aug 8 — Final Seoul Day
text:
Saturday · August 8, 2026 · Day 14 of 15
  Final Seoul Day 🛍️
  📍 COEX · K-pop Pilgimage · 논현삼계탕 · Last Shopping · 설매네 · Lotte Tower Night · Seoul



Breakfast — Shilla Stay Seodaemun


  07:00–10:30
  
    INCLUDED ✓🍳 Breakfast Buffet
    CAFE B1F — Breakfast Buffet · Weekend Hours
    Full breakfast buffet included. Located on the B1F.
      



Day
Hours
Adult
Child


Weekend
07:00–10:30

        Breakfast included in your booking — no extra charge
        Kitchen closes strictly at 10:30 — don't sleep in too late
      
    
    
      📍 Shilla Stay
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Morning — COEX


  10:00
  
    📚 Library
    COEX Starfield Library
    Seoul's famous two-storey open bookshelves — thousands of books lining enormous walls inside COEX Mall. A stunning architectural Instagram spot. Free entry. COEX Mall itself is one of Asia's largest underground shopping centres — good for last-minute brand shopping.
    
      📍 COEX
      🗺 Naver
    
  

K-pop Pilgrimage


  11:00
  
    🎵 K-pop
    K-pop Company Buildings
    Fan pilgrimage tour of the major K-pop entertainment buildings. Most are in Gangnam / Apgujeong area:
      
        HYBE (BTS, TXT, NewJeans) — Yongsan
        SM Entertainment (EXO, aespa, SHINee) — Seolleung
        JYP (TWICE, Stray Kids, NMIXX) — Cheongdam
        YG (BLACKPINK, BIGBANG) — Hapjeong
        Starship (MONSTA X, CRAVITY)
      
      Most are just the buildings — no tours usually. Some have fan café areas nearby.
    
    
      📍 Find All
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Lunch


  13:00
  
    🍗 Lunch
    논현삼계탕 본점 — Samgyetang
    Famous samgyetang (ginseng chicken soup) restaurant in Nonhyeon. Whole young chicken stuffed with rice, ginseng, jujube, and garlic in a nourishing broth. A classic Korean restorative meal — great before a big final shopping day.
    
      📍 논현삼계탕
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Afternoon — Final Shopping


  14:30
  
    🛍️ Final Shopping
    Anything Missed — Luxury Beauty Round 2
    Last chance for any missed brands. Check:
      
        Hera — Korean luxury cosmetics
        Jung Saem Mool — celebrity makeup artist brand
        Heart Percent — indie makeup brand
        The Saem — skincare and makeup
        Final Olive Young top-up
        Tamburins (if you missed Garosugil)
      
    
    
      📍 Gangnam Beauty
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Dinner


  19:00
  
    🍽️ Final Korea Dinner
    설매네 — Final Korea Meal
    Your last proper Korean dinner! Make it count.
    
      📍 설매네
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Evening


  20:30
  
    🌃 Night View
    Lotte World Tower — Seoul Sky
    Korea's tallest building (555m) with Seoul Sky Observatory on floors 117–123. Breathtaking night views over Seoul's glittering skyline — a perfect finale to the trip. Includes glass-floored sky bridge.
      
        Book tickets in advance online to skip queues
        Best visited after dark for city lights
        Entry ~₩29,000
      
    
    
      📍 Lotte Tower
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Last night in Korea! Flight tomorrow at 17:45. Pack tonight — check-out and head to airport by early afternoon. Don't forget: Birch Coffee brunch in the morning!

Sunday · July 26, 2026 · Day 1 of 15
  Departure ✈️

Before You Leave — Pre-Departure Checklist


  Jul 23
  
    📋 3 Days Before
    Fill Out Korea e-Arrival Card
    Korean immigration requires an electronic arrival card submitted up to 3 days before arrival. Complete it at e-arrivalcard.go.kr. Have your passport, flight number, and accommodation address (Shilla Stay Seodaemun) ready. Saves significant time at immigration on arrival.
    
      🌐 e-arrivalcard.go.kr
    
  



  Jul 24–25
  
    ✈️ 24–48 hrs Before
    Online Check-In
    Check in online with your airline to choose seats and download boarding passes. Most airlines open check-in 24 hours before departure. Having mobile boarding passes avoids a queue at the airport.
  



  Tonight
  
    🎒 Packing List
    Packing List
    
      Documents
      
        ✅ Passport (valid 6+ months)
        ✅ Korea e-Arrival Card (completed)
      
      Electronics
      
        ✅ Phone + charger
        ✅ Universal adapter (Korea uses Type C/F, 220V)
        ✅ Portable charger / power bank
        ✅ Camera + memory cards
        ✅ Earbuds / headphones (for flight)
      
      Clothing
      
        ✅ Light layers (summer in Korea is hot & humid, ~28–33°C)
        ✅ Rain jacket / compact umbrella (summer is monsoon season)
        ✅ Comfortable walking shoes (cobblestone streets at palaces)
        ✅ Smart casual outfit for nicer dinners
        ✅ Light jacket for cave (Manjanggul is 11°C inside)
      
      Health & Toiletries
      
        ✅ Sunscreen (SPF 50+ — Korea summer sun is intense)
        ✅ Medications + any prescriptions
        ✅ Lip balm, hand cream (plane is dry)
      
      Money & Cards
      
        ✅ Korean Won cash (₩200,000–300,000 for first day)
        ✅ Credit card with no foreign transaction fees
      
      Miscellaneous
      
        ✅ Neck pillow + eye mask (overnight flight)
        ✅ Snacks for the flight
        ✅ Reusable water bottle
        ✅ Tote bag (for shopping / day trips)
        ✅ Small daypack for hikes (Seongsan, DMZ)
      
    
  


Afternoon — Departure


  13:00
  
    
      ✈️ Departure
    
    Depart Vancouver (YVR)
    International terminal. Arrive at least 3 hours early for international check-in. Korea Air / Air Canada routing to ICN. Cross the International Date Line — arrive July 27.
    
      📍 YVR Airport
      🗺 Naver
    
  


Evening / Overnight


  —
  
    ✈️ In-Flight
    Overnight flight to Seoul (ICN)
    Flight time ~11 hours. Gain 16 hours crossing the date line. Arrive Seoul the next day (Jul 27) at 16:05 KST.
  



  💤
  
    😴 Jet Lag Strategy
    In-Flight Sleep Plan — Reset to KST
    
      Vancouver → Seoul crosses 16 time zones eastward — the tougher direction. The goal is to land at 16:05 KST feeling functional, then push through to 21:00 KST bedtime. Follow this flight plan:
      
        

          
            13:00–15:00 PDT05:00–07:00 KST
            Stay awake — it's afternoon for your body. Eat the meal service, watch a movie, get settled.
          

          
            15:00–15:30 PDT07:00–07:30 KST
            Wind down — take melatonin (0.5–1mg low dose works best), put on eye mask and neck pillow, recline seat.
          

          
            15:30–22:00 PDT07:30–14:00 KST
            😴 SLEEP — aim for ~6 hours. This is the critical window. Even if it feels unnatural (your body says it's afternoon), use the eye mask, earplugs, and blanket. Avoid checking the time.
          

          
            22:00–00:05 PDT14:00–16:05 KST
            Wake up — ~2 hrs before landing. Freshen up, eat the pre-landing meal, open the window shade, get into Seoul headspace. ☀️
          

          
            16:05 KST00:05 PDT
            Land in Seoul — your body thinks it's midnight, but it's 4pm in Korea. The plan from here is on the Jul 27 page. 🇰🇷
          

        
      
      💊 Melatonin tip: low dose (0.5mg) taken 30 min before your target sleep time works better than the standard 5mg pill. Available at Shoppers Drug Mart before the flight.
    
  

Tip: T-money transit card comes free with your LG U+ SIM — pick up the SIM at Gate A, T1 Arrivals right after landing.
